property_summary: For every call to C.transfer(from,caddress,_tos,v) when caddress implements transferFrom(address,address,uint256), the reference contract successfully calls that external function for each _tos (so transfer(...) returns true / does not revert); the mutant computes a wrong selector causing at least one external call to fail and thus transfer(...) can revert for some inputs.
change_summary: Change the bytes4 selector computed to an incorrect selector so the external call likely fails and causes revert on call.
